controlView.k9ae2cd: Execution starts at the first step; an empty "Next step" falls through to the next step in the list. Write steps go through full control checks and read-back and wait for the completion condition within the timeout. A condition whose tag has no valid value counts as failed; parallel branches must join at the same join step (all/any); loops are only allowed through jump steps with a count limit. On failure: stop (default), continue (record failure and fall through), or go to (e.g. a safe shutdown step; the run is recorded as failed). Saving checks for unreachable steps, missing joins and unbounded loops. If a step's tag requires dual approval, the sequence itself must require dual approval.

controlView.kb7e396: Every write from realtime, screens and sequences goes through: control ownership (local/remote) → tag-out → limits and rate of change → permissive/interlock → operator confirmation → dual approval (by policy) → write and read-back → independent feedback wait.
